articles.title: Angela Chandler, 66, Longtime Volunteer
articles.deck: Friends remember Angela Chandler for the many years of service to Cedar Hollow.
body: Born in Cedar Hollow in the years after the war, Angela Chandler spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood. Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Cedar Hollow.
Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Marsh Landing Pond Committee in his or her name. Angela Chandler died in May at home on Kiln Terrace, at the age of 66.
